srid.description:
Coordinate system for points stored in geometry column.

Interesting SRIDS:
   0 (Unknown)
   4326 (e.g. WGS84 Lat/Long - Used by Google Earth)
   3857 (e.g. Spherical Mercator - Used by Google Maps)

geoms.description: The collection of geometries that represent this object.

title:
Polygon (2D). A polygon is a representation of an area. The outer boundary of the polygon is represented by a ring. This ring
is a line that is both closed and simple. Holes within the polygon are also represented by rings.
name: GeomPolygon
